source_name: Держстат — обстеження «Витрати і ресурси домогосподарств України»
why_relevant: The household budget survey is the only official source separating cash outlays, non-cash subsidies, in-kind receipts and deposits/securities purchases at household level — a direct read on cash-vs-cashless household behaviour independent of the NBU.

source_name: Держстат — методологічні положення «Обстеження умов життя домогосподарств»
why_relevant: Defines exactly how cash vs non-cash expenditure categories are constructed — essential to avoid misreading Держстат series as payment-instrument statistics.

source_name: Держстат — доступ домогосподарств до ІКТ / використання ІКТ на підприємствах
why_relevant: ICT-access surveys give the connectivity and e-commerce base for digital payments adoption; enterprise ICT survey covers online sales, a proxy for card-not-present acceptance outside NBU reporting.

source_name: Єдиний державний вебпортал відкритих даних (data.gov.ua)
why_relevant: National open-data catalogue operated by the Ministry of Digital Transformation; the master index of which state body publishes which payment/banking dataset, with per-publisher pages, formats and licences. Primary snowballing hub for this cell.

source_name: data.gov.ua — реєстр наборів даних, що перебувають у володінні НБУ (каталожний запис)
why_relevant: A registry-of-registries listing every NBU-held dataset with id, name, formats and hyperlink — a compact machine-readable map of payment-card, terminal and payment-infrastructure datasets. Catalogued here (non-NBU infrastructure) rather than fetched from the NBU site, so no overlap with cell 01 collection.

source_name: data.gov.ua — сторінка розпорядника: Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб
why_relevant: Machine-readable list of DGF member banks and related datasets — the authoritative population of deposit-taking institutions for sizing card issuer / acquirer universes.

source_name: Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб (ФГВФО) — офіційний сайт
why_relevant: Publishes deposit-market aggregates (total household deposits, guaranteed amounts), insolvent-bank resolution and liquidation statistics, and activity reports — a non-NBU official read on retail banking penetration and on exits that reshape the card issuer landscape.

source_name: Антимонопольний комітет України (АМКУ) — офіційний сайт
why_relevant: Competition authority decisions and market investigations reveal acquiring/issuing market shares, interchange and merchant-fee structure that no statistical body publishes — e.g. the multi-year PrivatBank commercial acquiring case reporting issuer share of 55.3% (2018) to 53.7% (2024).

source_name: АМКУ — розпорядчі акти «Про проведення досліджень ринків»
why_relevant: Announces which markets AMCU has opened for study — an early-warning pointer that a payments/acquiring market report will exist months later.

source_name: Міністерство цифрової трансформації України (Мінцифра / thedigital.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Owns the digitalisation agenda and publishes research reports (digital literacy, regional digital transformation index) whose indicators include digital services and digital economy — context and adoption drivers for cashless payments; also the operator of data.gov.ua and Дія.

source_name: Індекс цифрової трансформації регіонів України (Мінцифра, щорічний звіт)
why_relevant: Region- and hromada-level scores for digital infrastructure, digital economy and digital skills — the only public sub-national grid usable to model regional differences in card/POS adoption where NBU data is national or oblast-coarse.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — звіти по державних банках
why_relevant: State banks (PrivatBank, Oschadbank, Ukrgasbank, Sense) dominate issuing and acquiring; the Ministry of Finance as owner publishes performance and strategy reporting that includes retail/card business context not present in NBU aggregates.

source_name: Є-data / Spending.gov.ua — єдиний вебпортал використання публічних коштів
why_relevant: Transaction-level public-sector payment records including contracts with banks and payment/POS/ATM equipment suppliers — reveals state procurement of payment infrastructure and acquiring service pricing that is otherwise commercially opaque.

source_name: Державна податкова служба України — показники роботи / застосування РРО-ПРРО
why_relevant: Tax authority statistics on registered RRO/PRRO fiscal cash registers and their turnover are the closest public proxy for POS acceptance points and for the cash/cashless split at the till, produced independently of the NBU. Its rulings also define when cashless settlement escapes fiscalisation — a structural caveat for any POS-count estimate.

source_name: Міністерство економіки України — програма «Національний кешбек» (звітність та новини)
why_relevant: State-run cashback programme executed through Дія and authorised banks: a policy instrument that directly pushes card usage and creates administrative data on cashless retail spending; coordinated by Mineconomy with Мінцифра, ДПС and Oschadbank.

source_name: Портал Дія (diia.gov.ua) — державні цифрові сервіси та новини
why_relevant: Delivery channel for state digital and payment-linked programmes (cashback, єПідтримка, Дія.Бізнес); announcements quantify enrolled users, participating banks and disbursed amounts — an administrative window on cashless flows separate from statistical reporting.

source_name: data.europa.eu — profile of Ukraine's data.gov.ua open data ecosystem
why_relevant: EU-side description of the Ukrainian portal's scale (~80k datasets), governance and technology — useful for assessing reliability and harvestability of the whole open-data channel, and a bridge to EU-side mirrors.

source_name: PaySpace Magazine Ukraine (psm7.com)
why_relevant: Dedicated Ukrainian-language trade portal on fintech, payment systems, e-commerce and cards. Regularly republishes and interprets NBU payment statistics (card counts, POS terminals, ATM network, cashless share) and runs interviews with NBU payment-systems officials, bank and PSP executives.

source_name: Fintech Insider Ukraine
why_relevant: Ukrainian fintech trade media with a dense, dated interview stream with bank and PSP executives (Sense Bank, PUMB, NovaPay, iPay.ua, Moneyveo). Exactly the channel where executives disclose volumes, terminal/card counts and cashless dynamics that never reach formal publications.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — finance portal and bank statistics index
why_relevant: High-traffic Ukrainian finance portal that fast-reports NBU payment-system releases in uk (e.g. card payments growing while the ATM network stays flat) and maintains a structured bank-indicator statistics section, giving both narrative and tabular access points.

source_name: Finclub.net (Фінансовий клуб)
why_relevant: Specialist Ukrainian banking news agency with dedicated 'Пряма мова' (direct speech / interview), 'Розслідування' and 'Інфографіка' sections, and its own round tables with bank executives. Strong on second-tier and regional banks. Fetch showed payment/ATM statistics are NOT its core beat, so treat as an executive-quote and bank-strategy source rather than a numbers source.

source_name: Banker.ua — Fintech Ukraine hub
why_relevant: Ukrainian banking trade outlet with a dedicated fintech landing aggregating trends, news and forecasts for the payment market; carries bank press-service commentary and executive quotes.

source_name: Finance.ua
why_relevant: Long-running Ukrainian consumer-finance portal covering banks, cards and payment services; useful for tracking product-level acquiring/card pricing news and for corroborating figures circulated in local press.

source_name: Prostobankir.com.ua — analytics for bankers
why_relevant: B2B portal explicitly aimed at bankers, publishing banking analytics and statistics on the Ukrainian and international market including card products and channel research. Historically a rare source of comparative product/channel studies. Note: site is http and its update cadence should be checked — possible partially dormant archive, which still has value as a historical baseline.

source_name: Bankografo.com — Ukrainian bank analysis
why_relevant: Analytical portal turning NBU banking-system data into charts, tables and research notes; useful as an independent local cross-check on aggregates and for spotting institution-level shifts behind payment/ATM investment decisions.

source_name: Finbalance — banking section
why_relevant: Ukrainian economics/finance outlet with a high-volume banking feed that relays NBU releases and bank disclosures quickly; good low-latency tripwire for new payment-statistics publications and for regional bank news.

source_name: Mind.ua
why_relevant: Business/finance analytical outlet publishing deep-dive pieces and executive interviews on banking, interchange/acquiring regulation and the cashless economy; among the local outlets most likely to publish original numbers with methodology.
